name: session-bar
description: A session status band above the prompt (context, 5h/7d limits, repo, model, cost, cache) that works in the terminal and in the desktop app

nerdFont.title: Nerd Font glyphs
nerdFont.description: Use Nerd Font glyphs in the terminal (rounded bar and pill ends, a bolt for the cache rate). Turn on only if your terminal font is a Nerd Font. The desktop app always uses plain shapes.
